purpose: Expand the teacher data pool toward SFT minimum scale: 8 unused rl_train tasks x 4 candidates with a per-candidate temperature ladder, run under the audited blind teacher agent on the pinned tau2 mirror.

tasks.reason: Cup + desk-lamp two-item exchange; multi-item specification matching.
Hidden intent (cancel only non-gaming items); tests intent clarification.
Change full shipping address; multi-entity consistency.
Look up order number first, then conditional exchange; information-gathering order.
Return speaker + modify laptop; multi-operation combination.
Return item and refund to original payment method; refund routing.
Coffee machine + laptop dual modification; attribute preservation.
Return everything except the coffee machine; batch scope control.

known_limitations: The teacher and user simulator use the same model family, so same-source bias remains and is recorded, not hidden.
The per-candidate temperature ladder mitigates near-duplicates but is not a substitute for task diversity.
Layer 1 yield (valid-candidate rate, HOLDOUT/drift rate, dedup rate) is unknown until the run completes.
AUTO_PASS_CANDIDATE is not human-adjudicated GOLD and is not SFT-releasable.
Programmatic policy findings remain diagnostic until validated against human gold.
